canvas.role: Primary application/workspace foundation; never dependent on translucency.

surface.role: Content, cards, panels, reading and working surfaces.

soft-glaze.role: Persistent navigation and secondary interaction surfaces.

glaze.role: Floating controls, toolbars, navigation and interactive islands.

deep-glaze.role: Menus, expanded controls, contextual panels and elevated transient surfaces.

live-glaze.role: Actively manipulated, dynamic, ongoing or responsive activity surfaces.

productivity.exception: Transient modal/sheet transitions may exceed the viewport-area budget only during the bounded transition interval.

communication.exception: Active call or media activity may temporarily exceed the Live Glaze count when each surface represents a distinct ongoing process.

media.exception: Immersive media controls over content may exceed the percentage while chrome remains subordinate to the media.

administration.exception: Security-critical transient surfaces may exceed the count but must preserve strong boundaries and restrained translucency.

creative.exception: Direct-manipulation tool surfaces may exceed the percentage only while actively manipulated.

invariants: Content-heavy primary work areas use Canvas or Surface unless an explicit, documented interaction role requires otherwise.
High-intensity material area is measured only while simultaneously visible; offscreen and fully occluded surfaces do not consume the viewport-area budget.
Reduced Transparency and Forced Colors override user-selected Clear or Balanced material rendering.
Performance fallback may simplify effects but may not remove semantic state, focus visibility, readable hierarchy, or required interaction affordances.
Ambient color may influence material tint but may not redefine protected semantic colors for error, warning, destructive, success, privacy, security, focus, or identity trust states.
Directional highlights follow active manipulation only and must not create false affordances on passive content.

criteria: Material use is restrained and reinforces interaction hierarchy rather than covering content indiscriminately.
Clear, Balanced and Solid modes each look intentional in Light, Dark and Deep Dark appearances.
Fallback profiles preserve composition, typography, geometry, hierarchy and distinctly GoreeCloud character.
Opacity, tint, boundaries and depth remain optically balanced over representative quiet and complex backgrounds.
